fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the FWLM serve as the backbone of provincial defense across a patchwork of semi-autonomous states, each maintaining its own military traditions and equipment preferences. Motorized platoons provide the speed the FWLM needs to cover the vast distances between garrison posts on provincial worlds, mounting troops on light vehicles that can respond to threats faster than foot infantry but without the expense of full mechanization. Configured for civil disturbance management rather than conventional military combat, these riot control troops are trained in crowd suppression, population control, and non-lethal enforcement operations on garrison worlds during periods of unrest.
